{{Quote|We've got the footage to prove it. But first, these words from Zavlabar's Gentes Grill -- home of the delicious an' succulent flash-fried nankling.|Ars Fivvle|<ref name="ActionTidings4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041021bespin4|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 4: The Empire's Ugly Nose}}</ref>}}
'''Zavlabar's Gentes Grill''' was located on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]], on the edge of [[Grukk's Jungle]]. It was a unique building suspended over open space by cables and [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] bladders. It previously was a residential mansion and a luxury hotel before becoming a restaurant. It was [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] first [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] restaurant that brought the majority of its gourmet patrons from [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" /> One of the grill's most popular menu items was flash-fried [[Nank fly|nankling]]<ref name="ActionTidings2" /><ref name="ActionTidings4" />
